Warning notice: using AI tools in client work

Published 10 November 2026

Status: this warning notice was issued on 10 November 2026. We may take it into account when we consider whether a firm has met its obligations. It is not a new rule.

We have seen cases of firms filing court documents that cite cases invented by AI tools.

We expect every firm we regulate to check any AI-generated content before it is sent to a client, a court or another party. We expect firms to keep client information confidential when they use AI tools, and to make sure a named person supervises that use.

This notice applies to all firms and individuals we regulate.

Northbridge Legal Standards Authority. Test page, not a real regulator.
